# discord_threads (Data Source)

Lists the active (not archived) threads of a server, public and private, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_threads" "active" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `threads` (Attributes List) The threads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--threads))

<a id="nestedatt--threads"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threads`

Read-Only:

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the thread is in.
- `id` (String) Thread ID.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether only moderators can unarchive the thread.
- `name` (String) Thread name.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the user who started the thread.
- `type` (String) Thread type: `announcement_thread`, `public_thread` or `private_thread`.
